notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null); no hardware was attached and no hardware backend was run. No deviation from the card: the family-config decision and the MujocoDriver helper express the model; the card lists no entry_symbols, and both card models exist in the clone. The package serves the card's robot model src/robot/so101_simplified.xml (models[1]), the model src/main.py:231-247 resolves and passes to the task controller as robot_xml_path. It does not serve models[0], configs/kitchen_configs/kitchen_robot_scene.xml, because that RoboCasa scene names its mesh and texture files by absolute Windows paths outside the clone (scene line 7), so it is not self-contained; the robot model's meshes are under src/robot/assets. The scene embeds the same six SO101 position actuators (scene lines 344-349). The step action is data.ctrl, bounded per actuator by the model's actuator_ctrlrange (six position actuators, src/robot/so101_simplified.xml:157-162); cap.world.reset.v1 restores the model defaults. MuJoCo is not installed and cannot be installed where the gate runs (no network, no pip), so fake.py is a stand-in mujoco module: it parses the MJCF for the joint count, actuator count and control ranges, but integrates a placeholder first-order motion and resolves no mesh, contact, equality or tendon constraint; it was never compared with the real engine. The model sets no option timestep, so the stand-in uses MuJoCo's 2 ms library default (marked placeholder in fake.py; test data, not a device bound). The sim path (a backend that backends does not name, which imports the real mujoco) was not run. NOT COVERED: the MuJoCo camera images (the robot's wrist_camera and the scene's overhead_camera) and kitchen object/fixture state; cap.world.step/reset carry qpos/qvel/ctrl, not frames, and the scene is not served. Expected warnings: G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND (the fake is the stand-in library, not the upstream simulator, so native calls are not recorded and G7 has no fake surface to check) and G8.NO_UNIT x3 (the bridge-derived inputs ticks, action.ctrl and seed). No operator-required limits, so no site-limits.example.json is needed. No catalogue requests: only cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1 are used. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
